status: Post-result diagnostic uncertainty amendment; not prospective preregistration.
prior_results_seen: Primary model discrimination, calibration point estimates and other amendments have been inspected. These 15 model calibration bootstrap intervals have not been computed before this freeze.
objective: Complete uncertainty reporting for all 15 primary model rows already listed in the manuscript; no selection based on new calibration results.

bootstrap.algorithm: Sort prediction rows by stay_id, np.unique(subject_id, return_inverse=True); rng=np.random.default_rng(seed); each draw uses np.bincount(rng.integers(n_unique,size=n_unique),minlength=n_unique), mapped to encounters.
bootstrap.paired: Each model replays the same frame-specific patient multiplicity sequence. This matches the frozen primary evaluator.
bootstrap.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of finite estimates; all convergence/failure counts reported.
bootstrap.not_included: Model-development variability, adaptive analysis selection, and uncertainty from data ascertainment.

diagnostics.calibration_in_the_large: Offset logistic regression with slope fixed at one; ideal intercept zero.
diagnostics.joint_intercept_and_slope: Logistic diagnostic regression on prediction logit; ideal intercept zero and slope one.
diagnostics.implementation: Reuse the checked external WeightedCalibration after pre-clipping inputs to the frozen primary 1e-6 rule. Its internal wider 1e-8 clipping does not change these inputs.
diagnostics.point_estimate_preservation: Original metrics.csv remains unchanged; reproduce its offset intercept and joint slope within 1e-7.

inference: Exploratory pointwise 95% intervals, without multiplicity adjustment. Diagnostic fits are not applied to predictions.

validation.independent_scipy: Uncentered BFGS weighted Bernoulli likelihood with analytic gradient; normalized score norm <=1e-8.
validation.paired_draw_check: First three encounter-weight arrays checked against the original frozen cluster_weights function; full multiplicity-stream hashes agree across models within frame.
validation.percentile_recalculation: Recompute intervals and finite counts from each stored bootstrap array.
